text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. Once the main goals are defined, it helps to break the project into milestones—key points in time that show your progress. You should also identify your deliverables, the concrete results or products you will hand over at the end. Finally, make sure all stakeholders agree on the goals from the start. When everyone is aligned, the team works together more effectively and avoids confusion later. Good planning at the beginning saves time and reduces problems throughout the project.
